Hi,

the verbose output, especially for the crosstalk calibration was very
useful. FYI, Mark asked you for the output of sessionInfo() too; that
is important to have and simplifies any troubleshooting.

First, this is odd; it detects calibrated CEL files, but somehow they
are not "loading" properly. Second, there is probably a simple
explanation to it. Let's find it:

What does the following give?

print(getFiles(csR));

path <- "rawData/sanger1,CEU,cgpSet/GenomeWideSNP_6"
pathnames <- list.files(path=path, full.names=TRUE, all.files=TRUE);

path <- "probeData/sanger1,CEU,cgpSet,ACC,ra,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6"
pathnames <- list.files(path=path, full.names=TRUE, all.files=TRUE);
print(pathnames);
for (pp in pathnames) { print(pp); x <- file.info(pp); rownames(x) <-
NULL; print(x); }

/Henrik
